author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Browser intake validation duplicates the browser producer's runtime allowlists.
findings.consequence: The client producer and server intake can drift: adding a supported browser event name, error type, or resource kind in one file without updating the other would either drop legitimate telemetry or make endpoint behavior differ from what the browser code can produce.
findings.evidence: The intake module defines BROWSER_EVENT_NAMES at line 36, BROWSER_ERROR_TYPES at line 41, and RESOURCE_KINDS at line 56. The browser producer independently defines the same runtime sets in app/lib/observability/browser.ts lines 21, 26, and 41, and both sides use them to validate the same BrowserIntakeEvent fields before delivery/forwarding.
findings.recommendation: Move the browser intake allowlists and their derived narrow types into a small shared observability-intake-contract module that is safe for both app and server imports, then have both the browser producer and server intake validate against that one source.
